description: This file defines a static class 'TestExtensions' with extension methods for Task objects, providing timeout functionality.

classes.name: TestExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Task timeout handling.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Extension method that adds a timeout to a Task, throwing TimeoutException if the task does not complete within the specified timeout.

methods.name: WithTimeout<T>
methods.description: Generic extension method that adds a timeout to a Task<T>, returning the result if completed in time or throwing TimeoutException otherwise.
